product.title: Cuisinart Coffee Maker, Single Serve 72-Ounce Reservoir Pod Coffee Machine, Programmable Brewing & Hot Water Dispenser, 3 Cup-Size Settings, Stainless Steel, SS-10P1, Silver

reviews.reviewDescription: Made in Vietnam. Quality, craftsmanship and pride were obvious, even opening the manufacturer's packaging. Do yourself a favor, read/understand the manufacturer's instructions before using. They're not complicated, but this is not your old coffeemaker. If you brew your own, follow manufacturer's recommendations concerning fineness of coffee grind and the amount placed in the filter basket. Preferring our own ground coffee, we use disposable K cup coffee filters, (purchase separately), in the stainless steel filter basket, simplifying cleanup after brewing. Just dump the used grounds, rinse the filter cup and ss basket, and you're ready to go again; with very little coffee grounds going down the disposal. After 3 weeks of daily use we've had no negative experiences, once we followed the instructions. Because the brewing head and reusable filter cup are so well designed, (no overflow), the interior surfaces of the brewing chamber remain very clean. Water reservoir's easy to fill or top off, while still in place on the machine. We brew a larger final cup volume by doubling the brew cycle, using the same grounds. After the first brew, just pop the brewing head release handle, raise it all the way up until you hear a 'click', press down until the head engages, select your volume and hit the brewing button again. We removed the drip tray to accommodate larger travel mugs and don't have any residual drips. As others have noted, when the SS-10 pump engages it does make a surprisingly louder sound than one would expect. Wake up world, here comes your Java! Love that there is an on/off power switch. My only negatives involve the plastic chrome release handle. I don't completely raise the brewing head with the handle; it feels ‘weak’. Once released, I raise the brewing head itself to the 'fully open (click)' position. My only true criticism is the plastic chrome handle surface. It collects and mirrors accumulated fingerprints until you wipe them off. Otherwise, this Cuisinart Single Serve is the best coffeemaker we've had. We look forward to the unique 'clunk' of the pump when it starts our ‘good morning’ brew cycle.
reviews.author: AH4Q2XXWIYNATD34L4Q34UUNPT3A

reviews.reviewDescription: This is a very solid coffeemaker. The quality is superb compared to the Keurig brand makers. It has a much more solid feel and better quality insides so to speak. It has some weight and does make a little noise when making a cup of coffee, but it is efficient and quick in doing so. I love the different cup sizes of coffee it can make. The coffee comes out nice and hot. I am very pleased with the price for the value of coffee maker.
reviews.author: AFJHJZLPBRWP7AN4HLJCIOSNBJGA

reviews.reviewDescription: Ok..I've had many many kurig coffee makers and they don't last and decided to try this coffee maker. My very first k cup maker like this was actually a cusinart. So...for those complaining....yes it is loud- ish....it is plastic but what isn't plastic. It does take a bit long to brew but Its because it brews better. It has a 2 Temps regular and hot. The coffee is actually hot and tastes way better then any maker Ive had before. The hot water and rinse is a nice plus. I like the reservoir because it's way easier to handle then the top brand. So no spilling. I like it's not too high and it's compact but not really because top brand is huge. The price is kinda high. I got the white and glad I did because it doesn't stand out like some massive thing on my counter and it's kinda attractive. As far as people saying it splashes...no...it really doesn't. My keurig splashed and was noisy. It doesn't look or feel cheap because it's plastic. I am totally happy I choose this brand and model ...it makes great coffee and easy to clean. So far
reviews.author: AGCG6WXR74BQXUEJ6LMBO7IBKZOA

reviews.reviewTitle: Great coffee maker, just make sure that the seller packages it properly!
reviews.reviewDescription: My co-workers and I pitched in to have this in our office. This machine is a gem. I love the Hot Water and Rinse features. Let me say, the rinse feature is the best! I ran a cup of water after someone brewed coffee and the water looked as if I had just brewed some tea. I didn't realize that there was so much residual coffee sitting around in there. Public Service Announcement: If you use this in a shared place, please be nice and remove your coffee pod then rinse the machine after you brew coffee! Maybe even check the water level and add more. It's super easy to do! You will become everyone's favorite co-worker, room-mate, friend, etc... They will think "Wow, (insert your name here) is so thoughtful and always making sure that our coffee maker is ready for the next person to use." You may then find little treats waiting for you out of appreciation. (Not a guarantee, but a nice thought) There is even a little hidden compartment on the side to store a pod for use with loose coffee grounds if you don't want to use a pre-filled pod. I have it set it to come on before people arrive for work, and turn off after they leave...for those who don't know where to find the on switch. (True story!, small kitchen appliances are hard to use apparently). I love, love, love that there are small charcoal water filter pods that sit in the water reservoir to help provide fresh tasting water. The coffee machine comes with one filter. I found a bundle deal that had the coffee maker and a package of 12 extra filters. I use a tall mug and have to take out the bottom tray to make it fit. It would be nice if there was a little more room to fit taller mugs. Removing that tray every time I use it gets a little annoying. The biggest downside was that the machine stopped working after about a week. The menu option was stuck on "Open Head" and wouldn't let anyone brew anything or even get hot water. A couple of us tried all the troubleshooting tips and nothing worked. I chatted in with Amazon and they connected me to Cuisinart. It took about an hour to get the call through, which was a little frustrating, but I figured this is a busy time of year and was patient. I was emailed a shipping label to return the non-working machine and Cuisinart sent a new one to me before waiting to get the old one back. I was very happy with the customer service by both Amazon Product Support and Cuisinart. The only thing I can think that may have happened was possibly some damage during transit. When the original coffee maker was shipped to me, it was sitting at my front door in only the product box that it was packaged in, like if I had bought it at the store myself. No outside box with any kind of padding to protect against getting knocked around during transit. When I opened the box, there was no kind of packaging on the top to protect the machine. You know, the heavy cardboard type thing that fits around the product? Gone! There was one on the bottom. Needless to say, I wasn't very happy about the way this was shipped. I also question if it was really a new machine if parts of the inside packaging were missing. It looked new and I took it into work hoping for the best. I just received my new one from Cuisinart and it came with all the packing materials and it was inside of another box nicely padded! I will be using this nice box and padding to send back to old one today, although I was tempted to send it back exactly how I received it. Since I am sending it to Cuisinart, and not who I bought it from, I decided to package it the right way for a return. I bought this from Amazon.com, Services, Inc, so I thought that the shipping packing would be a little better that what I got! Overall, my co-workers and I are happy with the Cuisinart SS-10 Single Serve Coffee Maker and we are looking forward to a long lasting relationship with the new one sent from the manufacturer.
reviews.author: AFPGQKYARQUJ7KCM6OU7JUJ5BDQQ

reviews.reviewDescription: After 12 years, sadly we had to replace our Cuisinart SS-700 because it finally stopped working and there is no way to fix it anymore. There didn’t seem many high quality single serving pod coffee makers to choose from, and since we had been very happy with our SS-700 plus all the other Cuisinart small appliances we own, we chose to go with the SS-10. After using it for one day, am already having serious doubts about the SS-10. Thus far, the SS-10 has it has failed to live up to the stellar Cuisinart reputation. The SS-700 brewed a single cup of coffee quickly and quietly. The SS-10, however, is the complete opposite of the SS-700. The SS-10 is extremely noisy, brews a cup SO incredibly slow and all the while sputters, splashes, squeals, and makes other disturbing noises. The SS-700 had a heating boiler for the water, which resulted in quick turnarounds for second, third and fourth cups of coffee – the SS-10 is different which, I am guessing, is what results in the very slow brewing cycle. The actual weight of the SS-10 is so much lighter than the SS-100, perhaps because it seems as if the entire unit is cheaply made with everything cheap painted plastic. The old model, we could fit a 16oz cup but this model, because the pod holder doesn’t swing up/tilt out – instead it is a giant "piece of fixed plastic resulting in a significant loss of height from the drip tray to the output nozzle. This entire unit feels cheaply made and as if any of the plastic parts could break at anytime. Cuisinart also replaced the sturdy metal needle of the SS-700 model with a piece of angle cut plastic in the SS-10, which is NOT sharp. The tops of the pods are being ripped, not punctured. And when you press the brew button -from "Brew" to "Open Head" takes over a full minute and a half to brew a 10 oz cup. At this point the machine annoyingly loud which is compounded with the rattling vibrations of the machine. (loud enough to wake anyone else who might still be sleeping). The SS-700 made the low, but quiet grumble when it pulled in water from the tank, before and after the Brew cycle followed by going quiet during the Brew, while brewing the coffee for a 16oz cup in under 30 seconds. I am so very very disappointed with Cuisinart for cheapening a product that was high quality. Although I have had the unit for only one day, what I have experienced thus far is making me regret buying this unit and am most likely going to be returning it (luckily I kept all the packaging materials). All I want first thing in the morning is a good cup of coffee made quickly and quietly – something this unit cannot, apparently, offer. I wish there was some way Cuisinart could go back to making the SS-700.
reviews.author: AES5WVELJCIWKC43AACZ5V6N5MSA

reviews.reviewTitle: Great for Coffee and Tea Lovers
reviews.reviewDescription: I really like this coffee maker. The large water reservoir means I don't have to refill it very often, which is very convenient. It comes with reusable K-cups, so I can use my own coffee instead of buying pods. I also use it to make tea with my favorite loose tea or tea bags. It's easy to use, versatile, and saves money by letting me brew exactly what I want. A great choice for anyone who enjoys both coffee and tea.
reviews.author: AH62JTMZVXRIAHFFFLJ2QZM5D4OQ

reviews.reviewTitle: Much Better Than the Leading Brand of Pod Coffee Makers
reviews.reviewDescription: I have had several over the years pod coffee makers from the leading brand. In the past they performed very well and lasted years. Recently I have had nothing but problems with those pod makers lasting just over a year and then they stop working. After having two of them last only 1 year I decided to try another brand. That's what lead me to give the Cuisinart a try. I can't vouch for the longevity yet but the functionality of the machine is so much better than the leading brand. It works totally different and I like it much better. It is much faster making successive cups than the other brand. It is also better built right down to the needles that puncture the coffee pod. It is better looking too. I would say the coffee is as good or a tad better than the leading brand pod maker. The lid mechanism is very strong. The function settings are very easy to set. It does have a blue display screen that looks nice but they need to add contrast to the lettering to make it a bit easier to read. One other addition for future models would be some kind of illumination in the water tank making it easier to tell the water level. Out of the box I love this machine much better than the other brand function wise. If it hold up that will be the icing on the cake. UPDATE: ALL OWNERS OF THIS MACHINE PLEASE READ: I too at times as some reviewers have stated have encountered the top punched hole on the top of the K-pod being punched larger than normal by the closing of the lid by the machine causing some grounds to come out of the pod into the coffee. I have found a simple solution that requires no altering or tampering with the machine. Here is what I do and so far no more grounds spilling out. I have gone through dozens of pods with no problems. When placing the K-pod in the machine receptacle use both thumbs on each side of the K-pod and press it down until to hear the distinct snap of the bottom of the pod being punctured by the needle. After that just close the lid as usual. Problem solved. I have made dozens and dozens of cups of coffee and the top hole punched by the machine is perfect with no enlargement or tears.
reviews.author: AE6OJQZR3SYSIAU23SOFIWDNUYIQ

reviews.reviewTitle: THE BEST CUP OF COFFEE IN ONE MINUTE
reviews.reviewDescription: Approximately 12 years ago before the Christmas holidays, Keurig flooded the TV air waves with commercials for their new K cup pod coffee maker that quickly brewed one cup of coffee. I liked the concept but never heard of Keurig and had no idea who they were or if they were a legitimate company or merely a scam so I didn’t buy their coffee maker. On January 5, 2011 I was shopping in Costco and saw a Cuisinart K cup coffee maker. Having a Cuisinart food processor, can opener, toaster and conventional coffee maker I was familiar with the company and the fine quality of their products. It used the K pods that the other company’s coffee maker used. It was love at first site and I bought the Cuisinart SS780PC coffee maker for $164.99. I loved that coffee maker and used her to pleasure myself every day and some days two, three and more times a day. We’ll here it is 11+ years later and she started to wear out from old age. The pump was sluggish and would no longer pump out a full 12 ounce mug of coffee. I sip and savor every one of those perfectly brewed 12 ounces of coffee. So I felt let me buy the current Cuisinart replacement for the model SS780PC I presently had and I went directly to Amazon and found the SS10 Cuisinart coffee maker and bought it immediately for $139.95. I was impressed with the voluminous number of 5 star reviews and I never pay any mind to an occasional 1 or 2 star review. Negative people write negative reviews and attempt to punish the manufacturer for mishaps caused by their own ignorance. Case in point splashing on the counter top. Possibly Sir Issac Newton could explain it better but if common sense prevailed there would be no splashing on the counter top. When a liquid drips from a higher point down to a standing liquid at a lower point the drops that are standing will splash up from being hit by the falling drops from above, especially if you use a shallow low sided tea cup. If a couple drops splash wipe it up with a paper towel, it’s not the fault of Cuisinart and it’s no big deal. Certainly not rocket science but basic rules of gravity. This new model does not have the blue light illuminatIng the water reservoir when water is low and has two heat settings HOT and VERY HOT rather than multiple degree settings. The engineers at Cuisinart realized these two features are not critical and designed a much better coffee maker for a $25 lower price eleven years after their original model was manufactured I loved my SS780PC but will have a torrid romance with this SS10. It is well designed and attractive, aesthetically adds to the beauty of my custom designed and handsomely decorated gourmet kitchen. I turn it on and immediately the open head icon illuminates, I put in a K pod and in less than one minute I’m sipping a 12 ounce mug of freshly brewed delicious and satisfying coffee. On top of that Cuisinart gives you a three year warranty. Talk about a manufacturer having faith in their product’s quality. I’m so glad I was skeptical years ago and never bought a Keurig. My old Cuisinart gave me 11 years of faithful service and I’m looking forward to a very long and enjoyable relationship with my new SS10. If you’re looking to buy a K pod single serve coffee brewer, don’t waste any more time looking. BUY this one it looks great, represents EXCELLENT VALUE, will brew you an EXCELLENT CUP OF COFFEE in a minute, is covered by Cuisinart’s 3 year warranty and Amazon will deliver it to your front door. GREAT PRICE, GREAT VALUE, GREAT SERVICE who could ask for more.
reviews.author: AHK4RNMS42UPJZBRJBLUKE5BPOGA
